conversation_recent.text: Thanks for those details, Dana. Before we get someone out — will anyone else be part of the decision, or is it just you?

I have been getting quotes for a while now and I have sat through several presentations already, so I know roughly what this should cost. The last company that came out gave me a number that was very close to what I was expecting and I almost signed with them that same evening, but I wanted to see one more option before I committed to anything. What I need replaced is twenty four windows across the whole house plus the glass sliding door that goes out to the patio, and cost is going to be the deciding factor for me on this one.
Sorry for the wait on that. I can have a specialist come out and measure, and you would have exact pricing the same visit.
